visualScopes: Visual-Scope: Maestro Canvas Run progress | active two-worker Run expanded dark | desktop, notebook | Primary supervision state must explain who is doing what without opaque IDs.

Visual-Scope: Maestro Canvas Run progress | completed Run with recent outcomes and cleanup warning dark | desktop, notebook | Proves 100 percent completion is separate from resource/projection health.
Visual-Scope: Maestro Canvas Run progress | blocked Run with nested child activity light | desktop, notebook | Urgent state, child ownership, blocker explanation, and next step must remain legible.
Visual-Scope: Maestro Canvas Run progress | compact then hidden with restore control dark | desktop, notebook | The panel must get out of the way without losing discoverability or urgent state.
Visual-Scope: Native Maestro progress | active Run compact and detail sheet dark | Android phone, Android tablet | Mobile must expose the same supervision detail with platform-appropriate density.

Visual-Scope: Native Maestro progress | completed Run with cleanup warning light | Android phone, Android tablet | Proves final 100 percent outcome and orthogonal health warning on both observed form factors.

Visual-Scope: Mobile pairing | stage-coded Metro or transport failure with retry dark | Android phone, Android tablet, web | Users must know which stage failed and how to recover without exposing pairing credentials.

Visual-Scope: Mobile pairing | successful host persistence and destination route dark | Android phone, web | Success evidence must prove the client leaves the scan route, not merely that desktop authenticated it.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-active-expanded-desktop | Maestro Canvas Run progress | desktop | 1920x1080 | active two-worker Run expanded dark
visuals.observation: The objective leads the expanded panel, worker functions and activities scan in order, and the next step remains distinct. Text is legible with balanced spacing; panel and controls stay inside the canvas without clipping, overlap, or horizontal overflow. Running state, progress, dismiss control, and technical-details disclosure are visually correct and have recognizable control affordances.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-active-expanded-notebook | Maestro Canvas Run progress | notebook | 1366x768 | active two-worker Run expanded dark
visuals.observation: The same objective, two current workers, and next step retain their hierarchy at notebook width. Typography and row spacing remain readable, the panel fits vertically, and no panel content clips or overflows; the terminal truncation behind the overlay is confined to the underlying resizable surface. State labels and icon controls remain perceivable.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-blocked-nested-desktop | Maestro Canvas Run progress | desktop | 1920x1080 | blocked Run with nested child activity light
visuals.observation: Blocked status, current work, blocker, and native child activity form a clear descending hierarchy. Light-theme contrast, typography, and section spacing are consistent; the child path and disclosure fit with no clipping or horizontal overflow. The nested activity is visibly parent-owned and the restore/dismiss affordances remain identifiable.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-blocked-nested-notebook | Maestro Canvas Run progress | notebook | 1366x768 | blocked Run with nested child activity light
visuals.observation: The blocker and child-activity sections remain fully visible and ordered at notebook size. Labels, paths, and descriptions keep readable weight and spacing, while the panel edges and disclosure avoid clipping and horizontal overflow. The blocked state is explicit without relying on color alone.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-compact-desktop | Maestro Canvas Run progress | desktop | 1920x1080 | compact active Run dark
visuals.observation: The compact strip prioritizes the objective, bounded activity, count, and Running label without card clutter. Text and icons align on one readable row with restrained spacing, no clipping, and no overflow. Status is conveyed by label as well as indicator, and expand/hide controls remain discoverable.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-complete-warning-desktop | Maestro Canvas Run progress | desktop | 1920x1080 | completed Run with recent outcomes and cleanup warning dark
visuals.observation: Completed and 100 percent remain dominant while recent outcomes and the separate cleanup warning are independently grouped. Technical identifiers use a subordinate monospace treatment with copy affordances; all rows fit without clipping or horizontal overflow. Spacing and contrast distinguish final outcome from health state, and controls are visibly actionable.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-complete-warning-notebook | Maestro Canvas Run progress | notebook | 1366x768 | completed Run with recent outcomes and cleanup warning dark
visuals.observation: At notebook width, 100 percent completion, three recent outcomes, cleanup warning, and technical details preserve their hierarchy. Typography remains readable and the panel stays within the viewport with no internal clipping or horizontal overflow. Outcome and warning remain text-labeled, while disclosure and copy actions retain recognizable targets.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-hidden-restore-desktop | Maestro Canvas Run progress | desktop | 1920x1080 | hidden panel with restore control dark
visuals.observation: The panel is absent and a quiet canvas control preserves the objective plus Running state. The control has clean alignment, readable type, sufficient separation from canvas tools, and no clipping or overflow. Its labeled status and bounded shape make the restore target discoverable without forcing the panel open.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-hidden-restore-notebook | Maestro Canvas Run progress | notebook | 1366x768 | hidden panel with restore control dark
visuals.observation: The hidden state leaves a compact restore control at notebook size without obscuring the working canvas. Objective and Running label remain legible, spacing is restrained, and no edge clipping or horizontal overflow appears. The persistent text label gives the control an accessible visual purpose.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-mobile-active-phone | Native Maestro progress | Android phone | 390x664 | active Run detail sheet dark
visuals.observation: The phone sheet leads with Run details, objective, Active status, and progress before current, recent, next, and child sections. Type and dividers remain readable at touch density; content is vertically scrollable with no horizontal overflow or clipped controls. Close affordance, text status, and sufficiently separated rows support accessible operation.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-mobile-active-tablet | Native Maestro progress | Android tablet | 810x1080 | active Run detail pane dark
visuals.observation: The tablet uses a dedicated right detail pane rather than stretching phone-sheet geometry. Objective, progress, work sections, and technical identifiers remain clearly ranked with comfortable spacing and readable typography; the pane has no clipping or horizontal overflow. Copy controls align with their values and state is labeled independently of color.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-mobile-complete-phone | Native Maestro progress | Android phone | 390x664 | completed Run with cleanup warning light
visuals.observation: Completed, 100 percent, recent outcome, and the orange cleanup-health block are visually separate and correctly ordered. Light-theme typography and spacing are readable, technical details remain in the scrollable sheet, and the bottom continuation is expected viewport scrolling rather than control clipping; there is no horizontal overflow. Close and copy controls are recognizable and the warning includes text, not color alone.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-mobile-complete-tablet | Native Maestro progress | Android tablet | 810x1080 | completed Run with cleanup warning light
visuals.observation: The tablet pane clearly separates final completion from cleanup health and exposes all technical identifiers without scrolling. The fixed-width content column has consistent typography and generous spacing, with no clipping, overlap, or horizontal overflow. Copy targets align consistently and every status has a textual label.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-pairing-error-phone | Mobile pairing | Android phone | 390x664 | stage-coded Metro or transport failure with retry dark
visuals.observation: The red timeout summary leads into a bounded stage log and full-width retry action, with home secondary. Monospace rows wrap within the card, the newest failure remains visible, and there is no horizontal overflow; the older top row is intentionally clipped by the bounded log scroller. Stage icons, text labels, large action targets, and readable spacing make recovery accessible without exposing credentials.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-pairing-error-tablet | Mobile pairing | Android tablet | 810x1080 | stage-coded Metro or transport failure with retry dark
visuals.observation: The timeout summary, wider diagnostic log, retry button, and home action remain centered in a clear vertical sequence. Monospace diagnostics retain readable line length and spacing with no clipping or horizontal overflow. Failure icons and labels complement color, and the primary action remains a large touch target.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-pairing-error-web | Mobile pairing | web | 381x840 | stage-coded persistence or navigation failure with retry dark
visuals.observation: The destination-route failure is dominant, while the ordered log proves earlier selection, persistence, and client-refresh success. Compact monospace type stays legible inside the card with no clipping or horizontal overflow, and retry/home actions remain clearly separated. Check and failure glyphs reinforce text, and the action hierarchy is accessible without relying on color.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-pairing-success-phone | Mobile pairing destination | Android phone | 390x664 | successful persisted host after route commit dark
visuals.observation: The destination screen replaces pairing diagnostics with a focused session-opening choice, proving route commit. Illustration, heading, explanatory copy, primary action, and secondary action are vertically balanced with readable typography and no clipping or horizontal overflow. Both choices are text-labeled and the primary button has a large touch target.

visuals.visual: Visual: och-pairing-success-web | Mobile pairing destination | web | 381x840 | successful persisted host after route commit dark
visuals.observation: The web destination has no residual pairing state and centers the session-opening decision on the tall viewport. Heading, copy, illustration, and bottom actions preserve clear hierarchy and compact readable typography with no clipping or horizontal overflow. Primary and secondary choices are explicitly labeled and visually distinct.
